## Details

<a id="arena2_colours"></a>
### [`arena2_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/arena2_screen_e400.asm#L6) `$E400-$E7E7`

*data*

Colour RAM of the arena that is not on screen. $8f8c swaps rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $d800. The hit-record bug at $87e5 reads $e422-$e425 as a hit record. Nothing reads the other bytes of $e400-$e7ff.

- **Read by:** [`check_attack_hit`](../combat/hits.md#check_attack_hit), [`apply_hit_damage`](../combat/hits.md#apply_hit_damage), [`spawn_hit_sprite`](../combat/hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)
